summary: _ansible_keep_remote_files (bool) tells modules that remote files may need to be kept; see DEFAULT_KEEP_REMOTE_FILES.
questions: How does a module know remote files should be kept?

answer_card.title: _ansible_keep_remote_files
answer_card.answer_md: Type `bool`. Tells modules to be ready to keep remote files. See `DEFAULT_KEEP_REMOTE_FILES`.
